findings.explanation: Your payments are conditional and dependent on [PARTY_B] receiving funds from third-party wireless carriers, which means you bear the risk of carrier payment delays or non-payment.
findings.suggested_change: All payments hereunder shall be payable to the Contractor in United States Dollars within thirty (30) days following the end of each calendar quarter, regardless of third-party collections.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello. I hope you are doing well. I would like to request a small update to the agreement before signing. - The relevant clause makes payments conditional on receiving funds from third-party carriers, meaning I would carry the risk of carrier delays. I propose updating this section so that payments are payable within thirty days following the end of each calendar quarter regardless of third-party collections. Best regards.
